newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss franc ends firm but dollar support holds.
newsitem.headline: Swiss franc ends firm but dollar support holds.

text.p: 1600 GMT - The Swiss franc ended firmer on the day, but the dollar was seen supported after it recovered from afternoon lows around 1.3675/80 francs.
"I expect a move up to 1.3815 francs. I would not sell short before 1.3830 francs," one Zurich-based trader said.
He said however beyond that level, which would mark a new 32-month high for dollar/Swiss, he would expect another downward correction for the U.S. currency.

The mark closed above support 86.30 Swiss centimes. From there, technicians said the mark could go higher if 86.55 is broken, but it may be difficult for the mark to break above 87.00 for the next few sessions.
Instead, the mark may hold in a band between 86.25 and 86.70 centimes.
* The dollar ended at 1.3755/3765 Swiss francs versus 1.3771/3777 francs at Monday's close.
* The mark closed at 86.36/39 Swiss centimes compared with 86.76/78 centimes on Monday. -- Zurich Editorial, +41 1 631 7340
